title: General Purposes of Sections 26-13 through 26-15

blocks.html: In harmony with the general purposes and intent of this Resolution and the general purposes of Section 26-11, the regulations of Sections 26-13 through 26-15, inclusive, are intended to:
blocks.plainText: In harmony with the general purposes and intent of this Resolution and the general purposes of Section 26-11, the regulations of Sections 26-13 through 26-15, inclusive, are intended to:

blocks.html: (a)        guide the location of arcades to assure horizontal continuity of developments with existing building arcades and to maintain visual continuity at street level;
blocks.plainText: (a) guide the location of arcades to assure horizontal continuity of developments with existing building arcades and to maintain visual continuity at street level;

blocks.html: (b)        require transparency and/or articulation of front walls to improve the visual quality of the street; and
blocks.plainText: (b) require transparency and/or articulation of front walls to improve the visual quality of the street; and

blocks.html: (c)        improve the quality of the street environment.
blocks.plainText: (c) improve the quality of the street environment.
